text:
noah-fin: Heads-up: small pricing experiment issue. Two customers were billed at experiment rates even though they should have been grandfathered. getting support pings.

tara-ops: Which invoices?

noah-fin: INV-2025-09-11-4411, INV-2025-09-11-4412 (custs: ALPHA-2, ALPHA-3). Looks like preserve flag was present but maybe parsed wrong.

zane-eng: We changed the CSV parser to be permissive for boolean columns. If preserve_legacy cell is an empty string we currently coerce to true (older parser coerced to false). vendor sent blank values for those customers. that's the flip.

ivy-revops: experiment service still shows bucket=legacy for both customers. so ingest behavior flipped truthiness for blank cells.

tara-ops: I can run a scoped backfill to set preserve_legacy=true for affected rows and recalc credits. I'll run dry-run at 14:10 UTC.

billing-bot: Alert: INV-2025-09-11-4411 flagged -> preserve_legacy=false; INV-2025-09-11-4412 flagged -> preserve_legacy=false.

tara-ops: Dry-run output:
```
2025-09-12T14:10:01Z INFO -> scanning 2 invoices
2025-09-12T14:10:02Z INFO -> treating empty preserve_legacy cells as TRUE after override
2025-09-12T14:10:03Z INFO -> INV-2025-09-11-4411 -> credit $4.60 (dry-run)
2025-09-12T14:10:04Z INFO -> INV-2025-09-11-4412 -> credit $0.00 (promo)
```

tara-ops: Plan to run live backfill at 14:40 UTC. zane: can you revert the permissive empty-string->true behavior and add an explicit mapping note in the importer?

zane-eng: Yep. I'll open a small PR to make boolean parsing strict and add a warning if boolean cells are blank. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/price-ingest/pulls/512

ivy-revops: I'll draft a short customer note: "We apologize for a temporary billing discrepancy caused by a data-interpretation change during vendor file ingest. We've applied an account credit where applicable; no action required. Contact billing@redwood.ai for questions." marco-legal, any edits?

marco-legal: Change "we apologize" -> "we regret" and add "no change to subscription terms." Also route refund requests > $750 to legal.

noah-fin: Thanks everyone. tara-ops: post the live run output here and then we'll close with a short postmortem and rollout checklist update. :white_check_mark:
